messages.content:
You extract business relations from excerpts of Meta Platforms, Inc.'s annual report (10-K, Item 1 Business).
Each excerpt starts with [p.N] = its PDF page.

Return JSON: {"relations": [{"type": ..., "entity": ..., "quote": ..., "page": N}]}
type is one of:
  "competitor"  - a company Meta Platforms, Inc. names as a competitor
  "supplier"    - a company that manufactures for / supplies Meta Platforms, Inc. (foundry, contract manufacturer, key supplier)
  "customer"    - a named customer that is significant to Meta Platforms, Inc. (e.g. accounts for a % of revenue)
  "segment"     - a reportable/operating segment of Meta Platforms, Inc. (entity = segment name)
  "acquisition" - a company Meta Platforms, Inc. acquired or agreed to acquire
Rules:
- entity must be a specific organization (or segment) NAMED in the text, never a category like "cloud providers".
- quote must be copied EXACTLY from the excerpt (8-30 words) and must contain the entity name.
- page is the [p.N] of the excerpt the quote comes from.
- list each (type, entity) once. If nothing qualifies, return {"relations": []}.

EXCERPTS:
[p.13] Competition Our business is characterized by innovation, rapid change, and disruptive technologies. We also compete with companies in the development and application of AI, particularly with respect to the development of frontier AI models, as well as the development and delivery of consumer hardware and augmented and virtual reality products and services. We also expect to face additional competition as we introduce or acquire new products, as our existing products evolve, or as other companies introduce new products and services, including as part of efforts to innovate through the development and application of AI and other new technologies as well as efforts to develop the metaverse.
[p.15] These laws and regulations involve matters including privacy, data use, data combination, data protection and personal information, the provision of our services to younger users, biometrics, encryption, rights of publicity, content, integrity, intellectual property, advertising, marketing, distribution, data security, data retention and deletion, data localization and storage, data disclosure, AI and machine learning, electronic contracts and other communications, competition, protection of minors, consumer protection, civil rights, accessibility, telecommunications, product liability, medical devices, e-commerce, taxation, economic or other trade controls including sanctions, export controls, anti-corruption and political law compliance, securities law compliance, and online payment services.
[p.17] Compensation, Benefits, Health, and Well-being We offer competitive compensation to attract and retain the best people, and we help care for our people so they can focus on our mission.
[p.20] Risks Related to Our Business Operations and Financial Results • our ability to compete effectively; • complex and evolving U.S. and foreign privacy, data use, data combination, data protection, content and content moderation, competition, youth, safety, consumer protection, advertising, and other laws and regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Digital Markets Act (DMA), Digital Services Act (DSA), UK Online Safety Act (OSA), Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act), and the UK Digital Markets, Competition and Consumer Act (DMCC);
